description: This Java class, MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector, is responsible for selecting and connecting an output MIDI port to a destination device and port. It extends MidiPortSelector and manages connections via MidiPortConnector objects.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
classes.description: A class that enables selecting a MIDI output port and establishing a connection to a specified destination device and port.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the selector with the specified MIDI manager, activity, UI spinner ID, destination device, and port index.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event of a port being selected by trying to connect it to the destination device port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes any active MIDI port connections managed by this selector.

methods.name: setConnectedListener
methods.description: Sets the listener that will be notified when ports are connected.
